title: Dallas specific use permit
source_agency: City of Dallas Development Services Department

permits.name: Specific Use Permit
permits.agency: City of Dallas Development Services Department

explanations.trigger_explanation: If a utility or related facility use is not allowed by right in the base zoning district, Dallas commonly uses a specific use permit process.

advisories: Public-hearing, notice, and site-plan elements are commonly encountered for discretionary zoning approvals.
notes: Tier 2: official city permit packet verifies the discretionary permit pathway; zoning interpretation remains project- and district-specific.
